description: Na₂LaNbSi₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.59 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-3.03 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.47 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.32 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.73 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.73 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-45°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.54 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Nb and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom.
